import dataiku
import dataikuapi

project_key = dataiku.get_custom_variables()["projectKey"]
project = dataiku.api_client().get_project(project_key)
variables = project.get_variables()
activate_continuous_build = variables["local"]["activate_continuous_build"]
logs_partitioning_activated = variables["local"]["logs_partitioning_activated"]
logs_partitioning_period = variables["local"]["logs_partitioning_period"]

scenario = project.get_scenario("4CONTINUOUSFLOWBUILD")
settings = scenario.get_settings()

settings.active = activate_continuous_build

if logs_partitioning_activated:
    period_to_partition_spec = { 
        "HOUR": "CURRENT_HOUR",
        "DAY": "CURRENT_DAY",
        "MONTH": "CURRENT_MONTH",
        "YEAR": "CURRENT_YEAR"
    }
    partition_spec = period_to_partition_spec[logs_partitioning_period]
    
    # update trigger watches.
    trigger_watches_len = len(settings.raw_triggers[0]["params"]["watches"])
    import json
    print("watches " + json.dumps(settings.raw_triggers[0]["params"]["watches"]))
    settings.raw_triggers[0]["params"]["watches"] = [
        {"type": "DATASET", "itemId": "eventserver_cru_logs", "partitionsSpec": partition_spec}
    ]
    for index in range(trigger_watches_len):
        settings.raw_triggers[0]["params"]["watches"][index]["partitionsSpec"] = partition_spec
        
    # update step.
    # build previous and current so some data is not left unprocessed. 
    # For example, in the interval between two builds:
    # CURRENT_DAY can change meaning, so the last logs of the previous day will go unprocessed.
    period_to_previous_partition_spec = { 
        "HOUR": "PREVIOUS_HOUR",
        "DAY": "PREVIOUS_DAY",
        "MONTH": "PREVIOUS_MONTH",
        "YEAR": "PREVIOUS_YEAR" 
    }
    settings.raw_steps[0]["params"]["builds"] = [
        {
            "type": "DATASET",
            "itemId": "logs_llm_usage_prepared_by_Project",
            "partitionsSpec": partition_spec
        },
        {
            "type": "DATASET",
            "itemId": "logs_llm_usage_prepared_by_Project",
            "partitionsSpec": period_to_previous_partition_spec[logs_partitioning_period]
        }
    ]

settings.save()
